# BD0 — Project Constitution

**Solution:** KSE Memory SDK v3 — Universal Hybrid Knowledge Substrate (SOL-01)
**Governance version:** 1.0 · **Authority:** gates every agent session — comply before writing any code.

## Principles

| ID | Name | Rule | Authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| GOV-01 | Evidence-gated claims | No performance claim ships without a reproducible public benchmark artefact in-repo (make bench regenerates it). | **NON-NEGOTIABLE** |
| GOV-02 | Zero-network default | The default install makes zero network calls and requires no API key. Telemetry is opt-in only, consent-prompted at first CLI run. | **NON-NEGOTIABLE** |
| GOV-03 | CPU-first | The default install and all default-path SLOs run on CPU-only hardware. No CUDA dependency anywhere in the default dependency tree. | **NON-NEGOTIABLE** |
| GOV-04 | Test-first | Write the failing test (TC-XX) before the implementation (FR/AR). Integration tests against local backends preferred over mocks. | **SHOULD** |
| GOV-05 | Typed public API | All public API surfaces fully type-annotated; simulations physically separated from empirical benchmarks under simulations/. | **SHOULD** |

NON-NEGOTIABLE principles (GOV-01..GOV-03) block merge on violation. SHOULD principles (GOV-04, GOV-05) require a logged BD5 decision to deviate.

## Tech Stack (declared)

- Python >=3.9
- pydantic v2
- pytest + pytest-asyncio + pytest-cov
- black
- ONNX Runtime (int8 quantised embeddings)
- hnswlib/usearch (CPU ANN)
- SQLite (local metadata)
- NetworkX (default graph)
- MIT licence
- PyPI: kse-memory-sdk

## Code Style

- Library-first, interface-driven (retain core/interfaces.py pattern)
- Optional dependencies isolated behind pip extras
- simulations/ separated from benchmarks/
- No deprecated openai.ChatCompletion API
